Annualized holders revenue

Dollars per year flowing to token holders via buybacks, burns, or fee share (30-day run-rate). rev fresh 7/28 (AAVE est · ETH carried)
HYPE: ~99% of fees buy HYPE via the Assistance Fund. AERO: fees to veAERO (holders share ~66%). PENDLE: ~all revenue to vePENDLE. UNI: TokenJar→Firepit burns. PUMP: 50%-of-net-revenue burn. JUP: Litterbox 50%-of-revenue buys. LIT: fee-revenue TWAP buybacks.

All metrics

Sorted by board rank. Click MC/Rev net for cheapest-net-cash-flow-first (the primary dial; net-dilutive and blanks sort last), or any header to re-sort. Fees ann. and Holders rev ann. are ANNUALIZED (30-day run-rate × 12.17). MC for ENA/LIT/JUP/PUMP uses CoinPaprika-implied supply (June-dated stamps — estimates). Trade vol 30d = monthly TRADE VOLUME on the exchange tokens' own markets (blank for non-exchanges): LIT from Lighter's own API (daily ×30); HYPE baked = spot orderbook only (June perp volume ≈ $267B, T3) though live mode adds the perp leg from Hyperliquid's own API; JUP = aggregator leg only. MC/Rev net = MC ÷ (holders rev − next-12-mo supply-in: unlocks + emissions at realized pace, the NETFLOW in-legs) — the multiple AFTER dilution; "net-dilutive" = supply-in currently exceeds holders revenue (sorted after all real multiples); blank where the in-leg is unknown (e.g. LIT's undisclosed vesting). NEW (owner 7/22 late): MC/FDV = dilution headroom (low = deep overhang — HYPE 0.26 · LIT 0.25; ~1.0 = fully diluted — ETH 1.00 · AAVE 0.95); FDV/Rev = the fully-diluted multiple, the overhang-adjusted lens (JUP: 22× on MC → ~47× on FDV).

Value accrual & dilution notes

Curated by Claude at each ranking run — mechanisms and unlock overhangs the APIs don't carry. Verify dates before acting.
Discipline: separate hype/narrative from business fundamentals; a token qualifies only if its value appreciates in direct relationship to the business (fees, burns, buybacks, staking revenue). No memecoins. ETH in scope; BTC tracked separately.
Reading MC/FDV: low ratio = large future dilution (HYPE ~0.26 and LIT ~0.25 — the deepest overhangs here); ~1.0 = fully diluted (ETH 1.00; AAVE ~0.95).
Price policy: live trackers only — CoinGecko, then Binance, then Hyperliquid; when none is reachable the last verified prices are shown as a dated snapshot. Fee figures are DefiLlama's 30-day run-rate, annualized ×12.17 — every figure passes automated integrity checks before it is baked; anomalous feeds are quarantined and logged in the open.
Legend: T1 = on-chain / independently verified · T2 = project-official · T3 = named analyst/press · est = estimate · net-dilutive = new supply currently exceeds the value paid to holders.
